goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann unternehmerische und politische Maßnahmen aus verhaltensökonomischer Sicht analysieren und die ethischen Grenzen von Verhaltensbeeinflussung und Nudging diskutieren.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Accessible foreground fruit and another accessible snack option illustrate a change of prominence while keeping alternatives available. Chooser and facilitator discuss transparency, free choice and fairness as open ethical questions rather than guaranteed benefits.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px both available food groups, two discussing actors and three ethical-question icons remain clear; no fine-print conditions are required.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px fruit prominence differs from the snack arrangement while neither route is locked. Question marks preserve ethical assessment rather than certify the intervention.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The facilitator holds a tablet with its back toward audience and screen toward her; public menu signs face participants. No actor-facing notebook is misoriented.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: Food positioning is a conceptual nudge example; the image does not prove health effects or that every intervention preserving an option is ethical.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
